_note: After 'Once upon a time, '. Frames. Templates. {UPPERCASE} slots draw a fresh atom each time; {lowercase} slots are the story's own fields ({first}, {place}, {want}...). {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} reuse something an earlier beat introduced: favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't. Tagged entries are favored in those genres. {SLOT:feature} requires a feature (see frames.py); verbs bind to the subject and object around them; {was}/{is} agree with the noun before.
entries: in {place}, there lived a {trait} {job} named {first}, who wanted {want}
there was a {job} in {place} named {first}, and all {first} wanted was {want}
{name} was the most {trait} {job} in all of {place}
in {place}, a {trait} {job} named {first} kept a secret: {first} {secret}
{first}, a {trait} {job}, was stuck in {place} with the {rival} breathing down their neck
in {place}, a {trait} {job} named {first} had one problem: {first} {flaw}

entries.text: in a cottage near {place}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, kept {THING} {HIDING}
beyond the wood, in {place}, lived a {trait} {job} named {first}, who carried {FEELING}
